bestBets.overview: NINE CIGARS finished too well getting his maiden out of the way this track/distance last start. He can take the next step and win again. LATE NIGHT TALKING is another coming off a last start win. Should sit off the pace and have last crack at these. LEVAR has been a little one paced in his races of late but he has been in the market and would not leave out of exotics while POWER MAIDEN chased home well when placed at Gladstone last start. She is never far away and must consider.

bestBets.overview: Going to have something each-way on MISHPAT in this. She led them up until late at Roma last start and although drawn wide she can cross and lead again and may get away with this. NOT HAPPENING comes into this off two solid placings. Still learning but she looks close to winning a maiden. SEIZING DESTINY is a debutant from the Belinda Mair stable. Placed in her most recent trial and looks ready for the racetrack while ALVITAR resumes off a long spell. Won most recent trial and she should be competitive fresh.

TORVECCHIO held her ground when finished in minor spot at Roma last start. Would not leave her out of exotics while MAMARAGAN was bit disappointing last start but he had been placed prior and would include in first four chances.
